description: The DMR Sled Enduro mountain bike frame has improved 2019 frame geometry with Offset Bushing. Slacker angles and lower Bottom Bracket. Fast!DMR Orbit Link™ suspension developed with industry guru David Earle. This DMR Sled frame has full suspension which begs to descend and is confident to climb. Alloy frame durability proven with DMR Team riders in 2017-18 seasons. The DMR SLED frame extracts the fun out of every turn and top speed from every decent. Refined enough for big mountain missions, while burly enough to satisfy even the most air-hungry inner child.
